name: cache-clock
description: A prompt-cache countdown in the status line, and a Compact / Handoff / Clear band once the cache has lapsed

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache keeps a prefix after a request. 60 on the normal plan, 5 while in usage overage. /cache ttl <n> overrides it and is kept across sessions.

warnMinutes.title: Warn under (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: Below this many minutes left the status switches to m:ss with a warning glyph.

showBand.title: Band after a lapse
showBand.description: Draw the Compact / Handoff / Clear / Keep going row above the prompt once the cache has lapsed.

compactAbove.title: Recommend compact above (tokens)
compactAbove.description: When the context is at least this many tokens, Compact is the primary button after a lapse; below it, Keep going is.
